verdict.summary: The change adds an always-emitted, bounded conflict-stage census without altering frontier selection or weakening any trust check. The pre-selection reservation snapshot correctly separates in-flight occupancy from keys acquired by the current frontier; collision, cross-cutting, GLOBAL-held, zero-board, ranking/cap, and no-double-count paths are covered by exact full-line assertions. Existing per-issue defer assertions remain exact after the two log families are separated. I found no blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
